<a id="claims-shown-in-context--语境中显示的主张"></a>
# Claims shown in context

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`claims-shown-in-context` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](claims-shown-in-context.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> With each claim in a context, what contexts show glues exactly where they agree where they meet, and a frame of context-free claims fits exactly where it glues everywhere; Specker's boxes and the two-qubit Mermin–Peres square glue nowhere. Parts fail a whole by not giving it back or having none.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Claims are shown in contexts: which claims lie within each context, and what each context shows of each claim at each configuration. At a configuration what the contexts show glues where one context-free reading agrees with every context on every claim within it, and the contexts agree where every two contexts a claim lies within show it alike. (`Becoming.Contextual`, `Becoming.Contextual.Glues`, `Becoming.Contextual.Agree`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Where what the contexts show glues at a configuration, they agree there; where each claim lies within some context, they glue at a configuration exactly where they agree there. (`Becoming.Contextual.Glues.agree`, `Becoming.Contextual.glues_iff_agree`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. Read with its context, everything shown is a claim of a frame on any process, a context, a claim and a value, realized exactly where the claim lies within the context and the context shows that value. Where each claim lies within some context, some frame of context-free claims, a claim with a value, on a given process fits every context exactly where what the contexts show glues at every configuration. (`Becoming.Frame`, `Becoming.Contextual.indexed`, `Becoming.Contextual.indexed_fits`, `Becoming.Contextual.FitsFree`, `Becoming.Contextual.fitsFree_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. Where what each context can show depends only on the claims within it, no context-free reading lies within every context's possibilities, and what every context shows at a configuration lies within its possibilities, what the contexts show at that configuration does not glue. (`Becoming.Local`, `Becoming.NoGlobal`, `Becoming.Contextual.Respects`, `Becoming.Contextual.not_glues`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. Where what each context can show depends only on the claims within it, no context-free reading lies within every context's possibilities, one configuration respects them, and each claim lies within some context, no frame of context-free claims on a given process fits what the contexts show, while the indexed frame does. (`Becoming.Contextual.no_free_frame`, `Becoming.Contextual.indexed_fits`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. What a whole of possibilities allows within a context, the readings some possibility agrees with on the claims within it, depends only on those claims, and every possibility of the whole is a reading every context allows; the parts give the whole back where every reading every context allows is a possibility of the whole. (`Becoming.restrict`, `Becoming.restrict_local`, `Becoming.Glued`, `Becoming.glued_of_whole`, `Becoming.PartsDetermine`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. Where no context-free reading lies within every context's possibilities and some context allows some reading, no whole of possibilities allows within each context exactly that context's possibilities; locality is not used. (`Becoming.no_whole`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
8. Specker's three boxes, any two opened together and exactly one of the two holding the gem: the openings' possibilities are local, no opening forces a box (each can show either way in every opening it lies in), and no placement fits every opening, no three two-valued boxes being pairwise different; a world showing the gem in each opening's first box respects them and does not glue, and they are the parts of no whole. (`Becoming.Unforced`, `Becoming.Specker.Box`, `Becoming.Specker.Opening`, `Becoming.Specker.within`, `Becoming.Specker.support`, `Becoming.Specker.local_`, `Becoming.Specker.unforced`, `Becoming.Specker.three_do_not`, `Becoming.Specker.noGlobal`, `Becoming.Specker.world`, `Becoming.Specker.respects`, `Becoming.Specker.not_glues`, `Becoming.Specker.no_whole`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
9. The Mermin–Peres square, nine cells in three rows and three columns, each line a context holding its three cells, whose values must have even parity except in the third column, where it is odd: the lines' possibilities are local, no line forces a cell, no assignment of the nine values has every line's parity, and the possibilities are the parts of no whole. (`Becoming.Square.Cell`, `Becoming.Square.Line`, `Becoming.Square.within`, `Becoming.Square.parity`, `Becoming.Square.odd`, `Becoming.Square.support`, `Becoming.Square.local_`, `Becoming.Square.unforced`, `Becoming.Square.nine`, `Becoming.Square.noGlobal`, `Becoming.Square.no_whole`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
10. Two-qubit observables realize the square as explicit integer 4×4 matrices: each squares to the identity, the three of each line commute pairwise, two sharing no line anticommute, and each line multiplies to −I in the third column and to I elsewhere. (`Becoming.Square.yy`, `Becoming.Square.obs`, `Becoming.Square.obs_sq`, `Becoming.Square.row_commute`, `Becoming.Square.column_commute`, `Becoming.Square.line_commute`, `Becoming.Square.off_line_anticommute`, `Becoming.Square.row_product`, `Becoming.Square.column_product`, `Becoming.Square.lineProduct`, `Becoming.Square.line_product`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
11. An integer vector shows a value at a cell where the cell's observable sends it to itself with that sign. Wherever a nonzero vector shows values at the three cells of a line, they have the line's parity, so what it shows jointly on a line is a possibility of the line; every possibility of a line is shown jointly by an explicit nonzero integer vector. (`Becoming.Square.Shows`, `Becoming.Square.row_parity`, `Becoming.Square.column_parity`, `Becoming.Square.line_parity`, `Becoming.Square.shows_support`, `Becoming.Square.lineWitness`, `Becoming.Square.line_realized`, `Becoming.Square.support_shown`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
12. No assignment of values to the nine cells of the square is shown jointly on every line, each line by some nonzero integer state vector. (`Becoming.Square.no_context_free_values`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
13. Along a run of any process, what the contexts show glues at a step exactly where the active claims of the world of readings at that step, each a context, a claim and a value, are read off one context-free assignment. (`Becoming.Contextual.FreeAt`, `Becoming.Contextual.glues_iff_freeAt`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
14. A contextual system of the square is quantum at a configuration where each line holds its three cells and what each line shows on them is shown jointly by a nonzero integer vector. Such a system does not glue there; along a run, the world of its readings is not context-free at a step where it is quantum; and no frame of context-free claims on any process fits it. (`Becoming.Square.QuantumAt`, `Becoming.Square.QuantumAt.not_glues`, `Becoming.Square.QuantumAt.not_freeAt`, `Becoming.Square.QuantumAt.no_free_frame`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
15. A contextual system of the square, each line showing its own possibility, is quantum at every configuration; so along every run of every process its readings are fitted by no frame of context-free claims of that process and are context-free at no step. (`Becoming.Square.quantum`, `Becoming.Square.quantum_at`, `Becoming.Square.quantum_readings`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No premise beyond the stated ones: gluing as agreement, and a frame of context-free claims fitting as gluing at every configuration, are two-way and need a context each claim lies within.
- Not gluing needs local possibilities, no context-free reading and one configuration respecting them, and the absence of a context-free frame needs also a context each claim lies within; having no whole needs some context to allow something, and does not use locality.
- The quantum realization of the square uses real integer matrices and integer state vectors, values compared entry by entry.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Only possibilities are stated, not probabilities; no Bell-type inequality is stated.
- General sheaf theory and the Abramsky–Brandenburger framework are not stated; only the gluing of values shown in context is.
- No general parity obstruction is stated in these laws: the boxes and the square are each checked by evaluation.
- The quantum realization covers only this square; Hilbert space, measurement and Born weights are not stated.
- That the parts give a whole back is stated for one type of values.
- **Counterexample:** Specker's three boxes and the Mermin–Peres square: consistent within each context, no context forcing a claim, no context-free reading (Specker.noGlobal, Square.noGlobal); qubits realize the square (no_context_free_values of Becoming.Quantum). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Context.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Following Ren's “push the frontier, as far as possible” of 12 October 2026, answering his “wave/particle” (sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-12-framing-and-pairs.md): the core's Frame reads claims as context-free by type; here that is named a commitment of the representation, with the condition under which it fits; what quantum measurements show is of the kind that does not glue (Kochen–Specker for two qubits, Mermin 1990, Peres 1990). The two ways parts fail a whole (not giving it back, as parity on Specker's pairs; having no whole) are the uniqueness and gluing conditions of a sheaf, for possibilities. AI readings: wave and particle are both projections onto context-free values; a value is what a context shows, a relation; the truth of Ren's speculation is relational. See §96 of the integration note.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- none
- related, not a proved adapter: [separation-loses-the-relation](separation-loses-the-relation.md). The other way parts fail a whole: parity is a whole its pairs do not give back, on the same three pairs.
- related, not a proved adapter: [readings-within-what-they-read](readings-within-what-they-read.md). Another limit of projection: holding every reading from within.
- related, not a proved adapter: [unity-of-readings](unity-of-readings.md). What contexts show is always the relata of one world, with no gluing; World's balance is the gluing of the standing's and the exchange's readings of change. The readings in context are the general case.
- related, not a proved adapter: [gluing-under-parity](gluing-under-parity.md). Answers its next step “the general parity obstruction”: context-free readings glue exactly where no selection of contexts contradicts, and where one does a mixture of context-free assignments meets on average at most m − 1 of its m contexts.
